---
name: Feature request
about: Explain a use case and why existing Simfinity capabilities do not cover it
title: "[FEATURE]"
labels: feature
assignees: ''

---

## Problem and use case

Who needs this behavior, what are they trying to achieve, and what happens today?
Include a minimal example, package/version and database engine. Remove private data.

## Existing capabilities considered

Show the current Simfinity usage and what you tried. Where relevant, consider
relationships, generated operations, query scopes, aggregates, controllers and
registered operations. Explain the remaining gap; mark untested assumptions as such.

## Why this belongs in Simfinity

Why is a reusable library capability needed instead of application business logic
or infrastructure configuration? Explain the impact on authorization, hooks,
transactions and MongoDB/PostgreSQL compatibility, or why a dimension is unaffected.
Identify engine-specific scope explicitly.

## Desired behavior and acceptance criteria

Describe observable outcomes, the smallest useful scope and any open questions.
Separate the need from a proposed implementation.

## Related work

Link related issues or documentation. Any implementation PR must link this issue,
summarize its motivation and explain how the change addresses it.
